verdict.rationale: Relay documents that most applications are reviewed within 1–2 business days, with status visible on the homepage and an email on decision. Once approved, account and routing numbers plus a bank verification letter are available in-app, and accounting sync and payment-processor deposits help connect existing tools. That supports a fast start, but nothing documents a complete switch-over within about a week. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding or migration timeline (moving payees, recurring payments, and processor payouts), initial card delivery timing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
